#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

pid=$(ps -eo pid,user,pcpu,pmem,comm,args --sort=-pcpu \
  | sed 1d \
  | fzf --prompt="kill> " --height=60% --header="pid user cpu mem cmd args" \
  | awk '{print $1}')

[ -z "$pid" ] && exit 0
read -rp "kill $pid? (y/N) " ans
[[ "$ans" == "y" ]] && kill -TERM "$pid"
summary_zh: fzf 列 process 確認後 SIGTERM
